title: benchmarkProcess
responsibility: Runs bounded benchmark subprocesses with cancellation and whole-process-group cleanup.

inputs.name: benchmarkProcess.input
inputs.description: Command vector, working directory, optional text input and cancellation signal.

outputs.name: benchmarkEnvironment
outputs.description: Allowlisted system environment with nested Harness analytics disabled.

outputs.name: benchmarkProcess
outputs.description: Child exit code and bounded stdout and stderr after process cleanup.
